about: The behavior library. Any object can mix these; the Studio shows each one's settings. Speeds are pixels per frame, times are frames (60 a second).

patrol.name: Patrol
patrol.help: Walks back and forth around where it was placed, turning at walls

range.label: Range
range.help: How far either way it walks

bob.label: Bob
bob.help: How far it bobs up and down

chase.name: Chase
chase.help: Goes after the player when they come near, then drifts back home

range.label: Sight
range.help: How close the player must be

fly.label: Flies
fly.help: On: chases through the air. Off: along the ground

shooter.name: Shooter
shooter.help: Fires at the player when they're in range

range.label: Range
range.help: How close the player must be

touchDamage.name: Hurts on touch
touchDamage.help: The player loses a heart touching it

health.name: Can be defeated
health.help: The player's shots wear it down; at zero it pops and counts as a defeat

bouncer.name: Bouncer
bouncer.help: Launches the player up when they land on it

solid.name: Solid
solid.help: The player can stand on top of it

mover.name: Mover
mover.help: Glides back and forth along a path, carrying anyone standing on it

dy.label: Up and down
dy.help: How far it travels up (+) or down (-)
